Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

highcharter (development version)

Bundled Highcharts JS: 12.6.2.

Breaking changes

  • With an empty mapping, hchart() and hcpxy_set_data() now pass a data frame’s color column directly to Highcharts as the point color, matching hc_add_series(). In tooltips for these points, use {point.color} in place of {point.colorv}. With a mapping such as hcaes(x, y), an unmapped color column remains available as {point.colorv}.

  • Treemaps and sunbursts use one color from the chart theme per first-level group. Children inherit their parent’s color. data_to_hierarchical() now omits the node’s color field by default. To fix colors explicitly, pass a vector to its colors argument. This replaces the highcharter.color_palette option.

  • Removed the R options highcharter.verbose, highcharter.debug and highcharter.download_map_data. For indented widget JSON, use options(htmlwidgets.TOJSON_ARGS = list(pretty = TRUE)). For maps outside the package, hcmap() downloads in R by default. Pass download_map_data = FALSE to load the map in the browser.

  • world_income replaces gni2014 with Atlas-method GNI per capita (current US dollars) and population for 2024 and 2025.

  • Removed the bundled geometries usgeojson, worldgeojson and uscountygeojson. Their hcmap() keys are "us", "custom/world-robinson-lowres" and "countries/us/us-all-all", respectively. The unemployment dataset was also removed.

  • city_weather supplies daily temperatures for four cities in 2025. Average temp_mean by city and month to migrate examples using citytemp or citytemp_long. For a daily range, select one city and use temp_min and temp_max. This replaces the weather sample from San Francisco in 2014. The historical globaltemp and mountains_panorama datasets have been retired. The showcase defines favorite_bars and favorite_pies locally, keeps the star sample with the article, and uses annual MCV1 coverage in place of the historical vaccines incidence table.

  • Widgets now use yyjsonr to write JSON. Remove options(highcharter.rjson = TRUE) from application code. Missing observations stay in their original positions and reach Highcharts as null. A missing optional field also preserves its point. For custom htmlwidgets.TOJSON_ARGS, the widget writer accepts pretty and digits.

  • Removed hcparcords(). Pass your measurement columns to data_to_parallel_coordinates(), enable parallelCoordinates = TRUE in hc_chart() and add the result with hc_add_series_list(). Use hc_xAxis(categories = names(measurements)) for the axis labels. Each axis now displays its original units. Supply series names or colors explicitly, one per observation. See the migration example.

  • is.highchart() recognizes the highchart and highchartstock widget classes. The legacy highchart2 class is no longer recognized on its own. Tibbles use the data.frame method for hchart().

  • New charts use the same English preset as hc_set_language("en"). In English, 12,345.67 uses a comma for thousands. To keep a space, use hc_set_language("en", thousandsSep = " "). Drilldown navigation uses the Highcharts breadcrumb labels.

  • Removed the google_fonts argument from highchart() and highchartstock() and the highcharter.google_fonts option. Bundled families work offline by name. Other plain family names use fonts supplied by the page or device. To include an external font with the widget, set chart.style.fontFamily in hc_theme() to sass::font_google("Noto Sans"). Use local = FALSE for a link to Google Fonts. See vignette("themes", package = "highcharter").

  • Give each Highcharts option in ... a name, for example hc_title(hc, text = "Sales"). Collections still accept positional objects, as in hc_yAxis(hc, list(id = "sales"), list(id = "margin")).

  • Renamed df_to_annotations_labels() to data_to_annotation_labels(). Pass the table as data and use xAxis and yAxis to select the axes for the labels.

  • Shiny event helpers now include the event scope in the input name. For an output named sales, migrate input$sales_mouseOver to input$sales_point_mouseOver or input$sales_series_mouseOver, according to the helper used. Read point clicks at input$sales_point_click; Shiny registers them automatically.

  • Removed hc_rm_series(). Select the series to include when building a chart. In Shiny, use hcpxy_remove_series(proxy, id = ...) to remove a series by its ID after the chart is rendered.

  • hc_xAxis(), hc_yAxis() and hc_zAxis() now accept one or several axis definitions. Replace hc_xAxis_multiples() and hc_zAxis_multiples() with the corresponding axis function. hc_yAxis_multiples() remains a deprecated alias. Replace successive hc_add_yAxis() calls with a single hc_yAxis() call. Use create_axis() to calculate relative panel heights.

  • Use highchart() in place of highchartzero(). In Shiny, replace highchartOutputZ() and renderHighchartZ() with highchartOutput() and renderHighchart() together. The regular widget applies the package options and uses the knitr figure dimensions. Set width = "100%" to fill the available width in R Markdown.

  • Use hcaes_string() in place of the removed alias hcaes_().

  • hchart() and hc_add_series() now draw a separate line for each ordinary xts column. One instrument with Open, High, Low and Close produces candlesticks by default. For mixed OHLC instruments, select the columns for one instrument per call.

  • The fast argument for data-frame series has been removed. Omit it in hchart() and hc_add_series(). Their point data stay editable as R lists until the widget is serialized.

  • This release replaces the per-preset constructors with one public constructor. The collection keeps tufte as its single Tufte preset. The theme vignette shows how to recreate the former tufte2 bar style. This release refreshes ft and economist and adds carbon, cloudscape and bslib. Cloudscape uses the AWS chart palette and Open Sans, with circular markers and gridlines on both axes. The bslib preset inherits Bootstrap colors and the base font.

New features

  • color_stops() accepts optional positions to place each supplied color at an exact point on the gradient.

  • hchart(ecdf(x)) draws an empirical cumulative distribution as a step line.

  • hchart() draws random forest error histories, cross-validation points and standard error bars for glmnet, and individual XGBoost trees. Cluster dendrograms preserve merge heights, and radial or rectangular phylogenies preserve branch lengths. Random forests compare multiple error curves in a shared tooltip table. Crosshairs on glmnet charts let you compare error bars at the same metric value. Model packages are optional.

  • hchart() draws classification and regression trees from partykit and rpart, and single C5.0 classification trees. Node area shows the number of observations. Donuts or bars show class composition and a color axis shows the mean response for regression. Light gray branches show the split condition in dark text with a white outline. Tree packages are optional.

  • hchart() draws one-way tables as column charts and two-way tables as heatmaps, preserving category order, dimension labels and zero counts.

  • hc_gridAxis() arranges pairs of axes in a rectangular grid. hchart() uses it to draw multivariate ACF, PACF and autocovariance objects with one panel per series pair and a common vertical scale.

  • hchart() now accepts type = "tilemap" and type = "contour" for numeric matrices. The default is "heatmap".

  • hchart() and hc_add_series() draw each geometry family in a mixed geojsonio FeatureCollection, with polygons below lines and points. Supply type to draw just one family. Both geo_json and geo_list are supported.

  • Charts, Stock, Maps and Gantt share one JavaScript bundle. Accessibility is included by default, including keyboard navigation (#755).

  • The bundle now includes the official chart types and common feature modules. A new highchartstock() widget adds Stock Tools, advanced annotations and technical indicators. Third-party Motion, Regression, Grouped Categories and Draggable Legend plugins remain optional.

  • hc_add_series_list() draws a single numeric value as one point, matching hc_add_series(). Histograms use the actual bin limits for their labels and draw unequal-width bins to scale.

  • Ten new option wrappers cover accessibility, map views, time zones, data imports, empty charts, SVG definitions, sonification, navigation, Stock Tools and Gantt connectors. Each has a runnable example in its help page.

  • hc_set_language() sets the language for new charts in the current R process. Chart controls are available in English (en, the default), Spanish (es), Portuguese (pt), French (fr), Norwegian Bokmål (nb), Japanese (ja), Korean (ko) and Simplified Chinese (zh-CN). Regional tags select the date and number formats used by the browser. hc_language() returns the corresponding options list.

  • Theme presets now use hc_theme("ft") and live in individual YAML files. hc_themes() lists the collection. hc_set_theme() selects a preset or a custom theme for subsequent charts. See vignette("themes", package = "highcharter").

  • hcpxy_set_extremes() controls an x-axis range from Shiny. hcpxy_set_data() can now target a series by ID, which is safer when Stock indicators change series order.

  • hchart() plots the original and adjusted series from a seasonal X-13 fit and labels its outliers.

  • hchart(stats::decompose(x)) displays the observed series, seasonality, trend and remainder in four panels. Series with frequencies outside the annual, quarterly and monthly calendars use their numeric time index.

  • X-range series accept Date and POSIXt columns for both interval ends (x and x2).

Changes

  • Data-frame charts and empirical distributions use the Highcharts legend default. A single standalone line, column or scatter series now appears in the legend. Supply name to label it or showInLegend = FALSE to hide it.

  • For matrices without row or column names, hchart() fits the axes to the grid in heatmap, tilemap and contour charts. The axes can still expand when adding another series.

  • Passing an lm or loess object to hc_add_series() now warns and still draws the fitted curve and its band (plus or minus two standard errors). Both methods will remain available throughout the first release with this warning. To migrate, call predict() and pass a data frame to hc_add_series(), as in the First steps example.

  • Widgets attach the Latin WOFF2 files for the bundled families selected by their theme and chart options. Charts using system fonts need no font files.

  • hchart() shows ACF and PACF as lollipops at their reported lags. Multivariate time series and decompositions use shared table tooltips.

  • Histograms created by hchart() use square corners by default.

  • The hcrt, carbon and smpl themes use regular-weight titles, labels and tooltip values.

  • The sparkline tooltip shows the point value in one outlined line and stays inside the chart at either edge.

  • The export menu defaults to three dots. The three Highcharts theme adaptations keep their original menu icon. Sand Signika tiles its sand texture at native size.

  • hcmap("jp") reads the packaged map of Japan by country code. hc_maps() lists the 202 country maps and five custom maps available offline. get_data_from_map() reads join properties from GeoJSON and TopoJSON. Other collection paths retain CDN support. The income example uses world_income.

  • ACF and PACF ticks stay within the correlation range, with room for endpoint markers.

  • Forecast charts distinguish observations, forecasts and prediction intervals in the legend and shared tooltip. The tooltip shows both interval limits. Custom series names are supported.

  • The hcrt and smpl presets use circular markers consistently across series.

  • The classic Highcharts themes use the 12.6.0 palettes and legend backgrounds. Dark presets have more legible axis labels. Monokai now uses four distinct series colors. The Bloom preset places its value axis on the right, and sparkline presets hide their legends by default.

  • The chalk, handdrawn and sandsignika presets embed their original backgrounds for offline use. The Carbon preset draws horizontal and vertical gridlines and uses circular point markers across series.

  • highcharter uses base R for argument validation, model predictions, row conversion and option merging. Charts of lm and loess fits now include the fitted curve and its two-standard-error band.

  • xts is optional. Charting OHLC prices also uses quantmod.

  • download_map_data() uses R’s configured download method by default.

  • Attaching highcharter in an interactive session points to ?highcharter for the licensing terms of the R package and the bundled Highcharts library.

Bug fixes

  • Table tooltips show whole counts without decimal places. Matrix heatmaps, tilemaps and contours honor hc_tooltip(valueDecimals = ...).

  • hcmap() and hc_add_series_map() use the column named by value even when the input already contains a different column called value.

  • Joined maps use the data range for their color scale. Adding a map layer with hc_add_series_map() preserves any color axes already configured. Use hc_colorAxis(min = 0) for a scale that starts at zero.

  • hchart.survfit() uses a logarithmic probability axis for fun = "log" and a logarithmic time axis for fun = "cloglog". Curves and confidence bands have gaps where their values fall outside the scale’s domain.

  • hchart() now passes series options to matrix, distance and ACF plots. ETS component charts also accept series options and layout arguments such as separate = FALSE.

  • Adding a forecast, linear model or loess fit preserves R’s random-number state when linking the fitted series to its intervals.

  • color_stops(1) places a single color at zero. Supply a positive integer for the number of stops.

  • export_hc() appends .js to filenames such as salesjs and preserves the JavaScript extensions .js, .mjs and .cjs.

  • Reusing one tooltip_chart() formatter across widgets now renders each mini chart in its own tooltip. The helper preserves JS() callbacks in hc_opts and accepts data column names containing spaces or hyphens.

  • hchart.survfit() draws a separate curve for each Cox prediction profile within each stratum. Confidence bands follow the corresponding curve, and censoring markers include times with multiple censored observations. Censoring markers now use their curve’s color by default. Use markerColor = "black" to draw all markers in black. This method requires survival 3.6-5 or later.

  • Boxplots from data_to_boxplot() place outliers at the same x coordinate as their box when categories differ between series. Hiding a single boxplot series in the legend now also hides its outliers.

  • Treemap and sunburst nodes from data_to_hierarchical() now keep the correct parent when labels on different paths produce the same ID.

  • Stock Tools now loads its indicators and embeds its toolbar icons in self-contained HTML widgets and vignettes.

  • Stock Tools can add technical indicators after another widget renders or re-renders on the same page (#595).

  • Data-frame heatmaps position dates and times on either axis and accept omitted coordinates. Date cells span one day. Date-time cells use the shortest observed interval on their axis, or one second for a single time. Set colsize or rowsize to choose a different interval in milliseconds.

  • Multivariate forecasts plot the predictions and intervals for each series on shared or separate axes. The legend toggles each confidence level across all panels.

  • Shiny proxies now send zero messages when there are no series to add, remove or update, or no points to update.

  • Forecast charts use the same time index for predictions and their intervals. Series with frequencies other than 1, 4 or 12 use a numeric axis.

  • data_to_sankey() counts transitions between consecutive columns, skips links with missing endpoints and assigns unique link IDs. Numeric binning handles missing values and tied quantiles. Inputs with fewer than two columns return an empty link table.

  • Axes with one category now display its label on the axis and in tooltips, including when the category is numeric (#395, #438).

  • hchart(data, type = "gantt") selects the native Gantt constructor for data frames, preserving task rows, date axes and dependency links.

  • Supplying a new rules list to hc_responsive() replaces the previous rules.

  • Circle-only presets preserve rectangular heatmap cells. The hcrt theme uses IBM Plex Sans for credits. French, Norwegian Bokmål and Simplified Chinese use official Highcharts language packs. Japanese and Korean use AI-generated translations.

  • hcmap() accepts an already loaded GeoJSON list without downloading map data. Network charts preserve the current theme while hiding their coordinate axes.

  • With reflow enabled, charts fill the available widget width and height in the Viewer and standalone browser, including after resizing. Percentage-height containers no longer leave the chart at Highcharts’ 400-pixel fallback height.

  • The Motion plugin uses native array iteration with the bundled Highcharts.

  • PCA charts now scale each component separately and label axes with the percentage of variance explained. Points are shown by default. Use loadings = TRUE for variable arrows and label = TRUE for observation names.

  • hcaes() and hcaes_string() evaluate expressions in the environment where the mapping was created. Computed axes show the expression as their title. Date and date-time mappings use millisecond timestamps. Grouped data-frame charts build point lists using row indices.

  • Data-frame charts can inherit the chart type or receive empty data. Point colors retain supplied hex values alongside missing values, and factor colors handle unused levels.

  • Heatmaps of dist objects now respect the matrix display options label and showInLegend.

  • Matrix heatmaps now use matrix positions directly, including when labels repeat or cells contain missing values. highcharter no longer requires tidyr.

Migration guide

Previous call Current call
df_to_annotations_labels(df = notes) data_to_annotation_labels(data = notes)
hc_xAxis_multiples(), hc_yAxis_multiples(), hc_zAxis_multiples() Pass the same list of axes to hc_xAxis(), hc_yAxis() or hc_zAxis(). The Y alias emits a deprecation warning.
hc_add_dependency("modules/...") Omit the call for built-in modules. Use highchartstock() for Stock Tools and technical indicators. Pass an explicit "plugins/..." path for packaged community plugins.
Repeated hc_add_yAxis() Collect the axes in order, then call hc_yAxis(axes).
hc_theme_google() and other preset constructors Use hc_theme("google"), or hc_set_theme("google") for a session default.
hcaes_() Use hcaes_string().
highchartzero() and its Shiny bindings Use highchart(), highchartOutput() and renderHighchart().
fast = TRUE in a data-frame chart Omit the argument. Point data are R lists.

The reverse-dependency review found calls to the removed theme constructors in highdir, RKorAPClient and UnalR. Their integrations need the replacements above. AovBay also references the previously removed hcboxplot() helper. Its hc_yAxis_multiples() call is covered by the deprecated alias.

Contributor acknowledgements

A special thank you to everyone who helped build highcharter in its early years, before AI coding assistants were commonplace. Dean shared his work on boxplots, Adline made it possible to plot a matrix as a heatmap, and Paul helped Shiny users update a chart without rebuilding it. Those features grew out of people taking the time to share an example, write a patch or work through a bug together.

I’m grateful to each of you who did that early work and to everyone who has kept the package working since. Thank you for your time and generosity.

highcharter 0.12.6.1

Changes

  • Highcharter now uses HighchartsJS 12.6.0.

Breaking changes

  • Removed hc_labels() in favor of hc_annotations(). This follows the Highcharts API change where the top-level labels option was removed. Users should migrate custom chart labels to annotations.

Package requirements

  • Updated Depends to require R 4.1.0 or later (R (>= 4.1.0)).

Bugs

  • Fix download_map_data to prevent 403 Forbidden errors when fetching data.
  • Wrapped examples making network calls in \dontrun{} (get_data_from_map and hc_mapNavigation) to fix CRAN Package Check 403 errors.
  • Renamed internal helper function hchart.pca to hchart_pca to resolve an unregistered S3 method mismatch NOTE.

highcharter 0.9.4

CRAN release: 2022-01-03

Changes

  • Highcharter now uses HighchartsJS 9.3.1.
  • Support highcharts gantt extension (#287).
  • Adding missed language options in getOption("highcharter.lang").
  • Adding hcpxy_add_series, hcpxy_remove_series, hcpxy_update, hcpxy_update_series, hcpxy_add_point, hcpxy_remove_point and hcpxy_loading.
  • Adding hcpxy_set_date and hcpxy_redraw thanks to @PaulC91.
  • Adding hc_loading for use with hcpxy_loading.
  • Adding hcpxy_update_point due @zevross (https://twitter.com/zevross/status/1403394816558383105).
  • Update jQuery from 3.5.0 to 3.5.1. This solve the problem in flexdashboard menu when the size of viewport is small (like tablets o phones).
  • Adding new data mountains_panorama.
  • Update pokemon data.

Bugs

  • Fix url in documentations via devtools::check_rhub().
  • Removing knitr.figure = FALSE option in sizingPolicy = htmlwidgets::sizingPolicy to fix #703

Internal

  • Back to previous definition in inst/htmlwidegts/highchart.js. From factory: function(el, width, height) { ... to renderValue: function(el, x, instance) { ... due this way the widget resize to use the space in flexdashboards (WIP).

highcharter 0.8.2

CRAN release: 2020-07-26

Changes

  • Highcharter now uses HighchartsJS 8.1.2
  • Adding data helpers to make easy certain type of charts: data_to_boxplot, data_to_hierarchical and data_to_sankey. Thanks to @wwwjk366.
  • Adding list to hchart supported classes to work with the new data helpers.
  • Adding hc_theme_sparkline_vb, hc_theme_hcrt themes.
  • boost module is FALSE by default.
  • Modifying highcharts_demo(), adding caption and credit texts.
  • All vignettes were moved from the package to favor to avoid CRAN check NOTE and warning. The content was moved to the new website of the package.
  • htmlwdgtgrid.css were removed from the yaml of highcart hchart widgets to avoid problems with others css frameworks when highcarter is used with shiny. Now hw_grid add htmlwdgtgrid.css automatically. Additionally hw_grid gain new parameters: 1) add_htmlgrid_css To add or not htmlgrid.css and 2) browsable -set as TRUE the default value- so now there is no need to use htmltools::browsable #622
  • Adding new hc_add_yAxis. Thanks to @nordicgit70.
  • Added option to switch to rjson::toJSON for better plotting performance. To use execute options(highcharter.rjon =TRUE). See #613. Thanks to @nordicgit70.

Bugs

  • Removing deprecated messages by dplyr #633 #637 thanks to @hdrab127.

Deprecated

  • hc_add_dependency_fa, fa_icon, fa_icon_mark, please use fontawesome package https://github.com/rstudio/fontawesome. See examples in the new website.
  • hciconarray, please use now type = "item"
  • hcspark, please use hc_theme_sparkline
  • hctreeemaps, hctreeemaps2, please use data_to_hierarchical.

highcharter 0.8.1

Changes

  • Highcharter now uses HighchartsJS 8 (8.1.0).
  • Highcharter now uses jquery v3.5.0; previously used is v1.11.1
  • Updates deprecated dplyr functions (@hdrab127, #637)
  • Fix warnings for numeric vectors with multiple classes (@nuno-agostinho, #635)

highcharter 0.7.2

Changes

  • Highcharter now uses HighchartsJS 7 (7.2.0) thanks to Daniel Possenriede (#552).

highcharter 0.7.1

Changes

  • Adding hc_theme_bloom based on Bloomberg Graphics.
  • Removed shortcut functions: hcts, hcbar, hcpie, hchist, hcdensity.
  • Removing whisker package dependency (#415).
  • Bullet chart is supported. Added bullet.js module to highchart.yalm (#482).
  • Add parameter quiet to download_map_data. Thanks to @DavidBreuer (#450).

highcharter 0.7.0

CRAN release: 2019-01-15

Changes

  • highchart function don’t load plugins as default. Now there is hc_add_plugin to load as required (#258).
  • Fontawesome is not loaded as default. Now there is a hc_add_depency_fa function helper to load as required (#257).

New Features

  • Highcharter now uses HighchartsJS 7 (7.0.1)
  • divBackgroundImage works with themes (#278).
  • New function hctreemap2 (#110).
  • New function hc_responsive to configure responsive features(#305).
  • New function tooltip_chart to create minicharts in tooltips (#343).
  • New function hc_boost function to configure boost module options module/boost.js (#382).
  • New function hchart_ which uses standar evaluation (#170).
  • New function hcaes_string (#248).
  • New function hcparcord. Inspired and copy from http://rpubs.com/hadley/97970 (#167).
  • New functions hc_add_series.lm and hc_add_series.loess (#271).
  • New function/theme Super Heroes (#286).
  • New function/theme hc_theme_ggplot2 to honoring one of the best packages (#260).
  • Added multicolor plugin (#251).
  • Added regression plugin (#262).

Bug Fixes

  • Adding encoding = "UTF-8" in download_map_data to read characters properly (#359).
  • Fixed Error in mutate_impl in hcboxplot (#323).
  • Fixed export_hc(..., as = "is") does not format javascript correctly (#398).
  • Added the MIME type to show fonts correctly (#308).
  • Fixed vignettes titles #244).
  • Fixed bug due conflict between highcharts v5 and draggable-points plugin (#273).
  • maxSize uses the default highchartsJS value (#272).
  • hchart.data.frame and hc_add_series.data.frame forces to be data frame to avoid problems with the data.table class (#263).
  • Fixed bug in hc_add_series_df when the data frame comes with a column named “series” (#241).
  • hchart don’t override/change default highchartsJS options (#302).

Api Changes

  • Remove deprecated list.parse functions (#259).
  • hc_exported was reworked (#247).

highcharter 0.5.0

CRAN release: 2017-01-17

Breaking changes

  • hchart.data.frame now gains a new mapping argument using hcaes function to define the aesthetics. After hchart(df, "line", x = xvar, yvar, group = othervar) now: hchart(df, "line", hcaes(x = xvar, yvar, color = othervar), ...) and therefore ... are used like other highcharter functions for give highcharts arguments to the series. See charting data frames vignette.

New Funcionalities

  • hc_add_series is a generic generic function (#213).
  • New hcmap function to chart maps (#218). And use remote sources (#215).
  • New charting data frames vignette (http://rpubs.com/jbkunst/230276) (#220).
  • New charting maps vignette (https://jkunst.com/highcharter/articles/maps.html) (#218).
  • debug as an option instead of argument. Example options(highcharter.debug = TRUE) (#216).
  • Upgrade to highcharts V5 (#154) (#208).
  • Added helpers & shortcuts for tooltip: sort and table (#206).
  • Added export-csv plugin to export chart data to CSV, XLS, HTML or JS array (#178).
  • Added Grouped Categories plugin (#172) (#193).
  • Added Tooltip delay plugin (#181).
  • Added is.highchart according with Best practices in http://adv-r.had.co.nz/S3.html (#179).
  • New themes: theme_firefox (#191), theme_tufte (#190). hc_theme_elementary (#184).
  • hchart.data.frame doesn’t override the color if the column var have a hexadecimal color format (#148).
  • Added hc_size function to change width and height (#146).
  • Add more data for nice examples: vaccines, weather radials, pkmn (#145).

Changes

  • renaming hcwaffle to hciconarray. The hcwaffle do not make a waffle! (#242).
  • removing colorize_vector function (#237).
  • viridisLite moved from imports to suggests (#236).

Bug fixes

  • Fix map using mapbubble (#209).
  • hc_add_series_map don’t remove additional data (#188) (#189).
  • hc_annotations accept multiple arguments (#171).
  • Adding specific version of tibble (#159).
  • hchart.data.frame allow change stops in hc_colorAxis (#147).

Others

  • Remove underscore as dependencies (#214) (#210).

highcharter 0.4.0

CRAN release: 2016-07-15

New Funcionalities

  • Include elementId to createWidget. Add the hc_elementId() to modify this paramter after the creation of the highchart object (#140).
  • hchart support data frames a la ggplot2::qplot (#136).
  • hchart support Principal Components objects princomp and prcomp charting a biplot. Thanks to @nuno-agostinho (#128 #123).
  • hchartsupport matrix objects charting a heatmap (hchart.matrix) (#86).
  • hchart support phylo objects (#64).
  • New hcboxplot, hcwaffle, hcbar, hcpie, hchist, hcdensity, hcts function to get quick some style of charts. Thanks to @nuno-agostinho. hc_add_series_density implementation (#99 #70).
  • New hc_add_series_bwp to chart box and whisker plots (#81).
  • New hc_add_series_list to add list of series (#68).
  • New hc_add_series_df_old (!!) shortcut of hc_add_series(data = list.parse3(df)) (#76).
  • Added hc_theme_sparkline (#132).
  • Added function to create dataClasses and stops arguments in hc_colorAxis (#120).
  • Validate length of data = 1 and apply the list function (#119 #188 #65 #71).
  • Added colorize function so colorize_vector will be deprecate in the next release (#75).
  • Adding hc_add_series_df similar to hchart.data.frame (#114 #115).
  • Annotation funcionalities hc_annotations (#103).
  • Added cross as marker symbol (#96).
  • New hc_yAxis_multiples to add automatically arbitraty number of y axis (#90 #79).
  • New hc_grid to create a grid of highchart objects, inspired from mjs_grid (#67 #66).
  • Add motion plugin https://github.com/larsac07/Motion-Highcharts-Plugin (#62).

Changes

  • Upgrading to highcharts 4.2.4 (#72).
  • Options were separated into highcharter.global, highcharter.lang and highcharter.chart instead of having all in one big list (#77 #52).
  • list.parse2 and list.parse3 deperacted and renaming to list_parse2 and list_parse3.
  • hc_add_series_scatter is more flexible and general (#54 #58)

Bug fixes

  • .hc_get_fonts now handle fonts names with multiple spaces (#107).
  • hchart.character now display empty levels (#101).
  • datetime_to_timestampdon’t break in certain cases (#97).

Others

  • At startup a message display mentioning that highchart, highstock and highmaps are not free for commercial and Governmental use.

highcharter 0.3.1.9999

  • Adding underscore dependency (previously was removed. Solves #28)

highcharter 0.3.0

CRAN release: 2016-03-28

  • Igraph support to hchart (#61)
  • New function export_hc. Take a highchart object and write a js file with the options (#60).
  • New function tooltip_table. Helper to create table based in tags from htmltoolspackage #59).
  • New function hc_colors. Function for the colors option in highcharts api (#57).
  • Adding funnel.js and gauge-solid.js to dependency for create funnel charts and charts like apple watch (#56).
  • The hc_themes_... functions gains a ... parameter to add styles to the current invoked theme (#53).
  • More themes: flat, flatdark, smpl, ft (financial times) (#49).
  • Don’t run error (\dontrun{}) to avoid quantmod package example in flags function

  • Implemenation of highcharts with boost module highchart2() (#43). This include highcharts.js, exporting.js and boost-module.js.
  • Highstock implementation/support (#10)
  • Highmaps implementation/support (#25)

  • Avoid duplicate css calls (#6)
  • Add uscountygeojson, usgeojson, worldgeojson, unemployment data
